item.title: Czech archbishop affirms solidarity with Ukrainian refugees
item.description: Archbishop Josef Nuzík and Protestant leader Pavel Pokorný affirmed Czech support for Ukrainian refugees after the speaker of Parliament accused them of exploiting the system.

item.title: Christian woman pleads not guilty to ‘buffer zone’ abortion clinic offense in UK
item.description: A Christian woman has pleaded not guilty to allegedly breaching a “buffer zone” law after silently praying outside an abortion clinic in the U.K.

item.title: Colombian bishops demand respect for Christ after President Petro’s ‘blasphemous’ comments
item.description: Following blasphemous comments about Jesus Christ, Colombia’s Catholic bishops demanded President Gustavo Petro show respect for Christ and for the religious beliefs of all Colombians.

item.title: ‘The answer to suffering is not to offer death,’ cardinal says of assisted suicide bill in Italy
item.description: The Italian bishops are opposing a pending bill that would legitimize assisted suicide and are also calling for greater investment in palliative care and support for the sick.

item.title: U.S. bishops join international delegation in West Bank, call for 2-state solution
item.description: Representatives of the U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops joined an international delegation to the West Bank, where they said conditions remain “catastrophic.”

item.title: Place Egypt on watch list, Commission on International Religious Freedom says
item.description: The U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom says Egypt should be placed on a religious freedom watch list after a Christian man was sentenced to five years in prison for critiquing Islam.
